subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions tolerate a generic body `model`, and should the same rule apply to sibling OpenAI-compatible endpoints?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the requested behavior changes a documented public API contract for model selection and could create endpoint parity differences.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: Treat the body `model` as client compatibility metadata when a valid agent header selects the agent, and add docs/tests for the endpoint set maintainers want covered.

options.title: Preserve agent-first model contract
options.body: Keep requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or an agent-target model and document SDK integrations to send that value with optional `x-openclaw-model`.

options.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose one precedence rule for Chat Completions and the sibling OpenAI-compatible surfaces.

recommendation.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose one precedence rule for Chat Completions and the sibling OpenAI-compatible surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested behavior changes the agent-first OpenAI-compatible model contract that vincentkoc introduced and recently maintained around these endpoints.
